description: HSMC is a privacy-focused Layer-1 blockchain written in Rust. Consensus is SHA-256d (double SHA-256) Proof of Work with Stratum V2 mining. The node ships Monero-inspired privacy primitives — RingCT confidential amounts, stealth addresses and CLSAG ring signatures — as implemented libraries; consensus-level verification of those proofs is on the roadmap, and the current wallet sends transparent transactions. A wrapped wHSMC ERC-20 token provides an AMM bridge to BSC/ETH/Polygon.
